# alchm-astro-core (Vendored)

## Provenance & Revision Information

- **Origin Repository:** `alchm-agents-solana` (`/Users/GregCastro/ASOL/alchm-agents-solana/alchm-astro-core`)
- **Crate Version:** `0.1.0`
- **Rust Edition:** `2021` (aligned with `pentacles-server` edition 2021)
- **Vendored Date:** 2026-09-02
- **Purpose:** Provides pure astrological enum definitions (`Planet`, `Suit`, `Modality`, `ZODIAC_SIGNS`) and dignity/element mappings shared between the web client, feeder companion daemons, and the SpacetimeDB server module.
